Credentry._Comment: Dev 'Sign in with Credentry' (run Credentry CE.Api on localhost:5144, branch feature/numbatwallet-federation). ClientSecret matches the DEV-ONLY value Credentry seeds for numbatwallet-admin in its own appsettings.Development.json (published dev secret, never used outside local dev; nonprod/prod secrets come from Key Vault). Registered redirect URI is http://localhost:5137/signin-credentry — run Web.Admin with the 'http' launch profile for the callback to match. TenantMap: Credentry tid -> NumbatWallet tenant id (instance-specific).
